app.buildMuscleKeepFat: Build muscle · keep fat in check · build a sustainable system.
app.naturalMuscleGrowthAthletic: Natural muscle growth · athletic look · fat control
body.goalNotNumberOn: The goal is not a number on the scale: it is muscle gain with a stable waist. Measure under the same conditions every week.
bodySvc.atLeastOneWeek: At least one week of weight entries is needed for a trend. Weigh yourself every morning, after the toilet, on an empty stomach.
bodySvc.paceFineNKg: The pace is fine ({r} kg/week). Ideal: 0 … +0.4 kg/week with a stable waist.
bodySvc.waistIncreasedByN: Waist increased by {d} cm — this may be fat gain. You may need to cut calories a little.
bodySvc.weightDroppingTooFast: Weight is dropping too fast ({r} kg/week). You may need to raise calories a little.
bodySvc.weightRisingTooFast: Weight is rising too fast ({r} kg/week). You may need to cut calories a little.
core.couldNotSaveLocalstorage: Could not save (LocalStorage may be full)
dash.afterWorkoutYouCan: After the workout you can add 5–10 min of easy walking (cool-down).
dash.extraWheyTodayN: Extra whey today: {a} scoops. Steroids, testosterone, SARMs and other anabolic drugs are not part of this program.
dash.ifYouFeelGroin: If you feel groin discomfort, replace it with walking
dash.inclinedTreadmill58: An inclined treadmill (5–8%) is a great choice
dash.markedAutomaticallyAsYou: Marked automatically as you add water
dash.markWorkoutAsDone: Mark the workout as done without saving its log? (Use "Save workout" in the Workout section to keep history)
dash.nDontHoldBreath: {a} Don't hold your breath; stop if you feel pain or swelling.
dash.numberOnRightLast: The number on the right is last session's weight and reps.
dash.numberOnRightWeight: The number on the right is the weight suggested by progressive overload.
dash.planLittleOffTarget: The plan is a little off target ({a} kcal, {b} g protein). Portions are limited. Try creating a new menu or changing the number of meals in Settings.
dash.resetAllOfTodays: Reset all of today's entries (meals, water, checklist, workout draft) and create a new plan?
dash.sinceMainGoalBuilding: Since the main goal is building muscle, keep cardio under 30 minutes.
dash.whatDidYouDo: WHAT DID YOU DO THAT DAY?
dash.whatShouldYouDoThat: WHAT SHOULD YOU DO THAT DAY?
dash.wheyProteinOnlyTo: Whey protein (only to cover a shortfall)
dash.zone2PaceYou: Zone 2 · a pace you can talk at
day.calorieTargetNKcal: Calorie target: {v} kcal. It applies to the next menu you create.
day.target79Hours: Target 7–9 hours · turn screens off 30 min before
dayDetail.menuWillCreatedWhen: The menu will be created when the day is opened
exercise.breatheNormallyDo: Breathe normally; do not hold your breath. Reps = seconds.
exercise.breatheOutAs: Breathe out as you push; do not hold your breath. Do not fully lock your knees.
exercise.forFirst6: For the first 6–8 weeks after surgery, choosing Leg Press is safer.
exercise.holdFor1: Hold for 1 second at the bottom.
exercise.keepChestUp: Keep your chest up and squeeze your shoulder blades.
exercise.lightToModerate: Light-to-moderate weight, back straight. Do not do a Valsalva (breath hold).
exercise.lightWeightUp: Light weight, up to shoulder height.
exercise.moderateWeightDo: Moderate weight. Do not sharply raise abdominal pressure; stop if you feel discomfort.
exercise.pullElbowsDown: Pull your elbows down and back; do not swing your body.
exercise.pullShoulderBlades: Pull your shoulder blades together and lower the bar under control.
exercise.weightPerDumbbell: The weight is per dumbbell. Seated, with back support.
exercise.weightPerDumbbell30: The weight is per dumbbell. 30° angle.
phase.doubleProgressionRaise: Double progression: raise the weight when you reach the top of the rep range. Do not train to failure.
phase.increaseWeightIn: Increase the weight in small steps. Keep 2–3 reps in reserve every set.
phase.techniqueAndAdaptation: Technique and adaptation. Keep 3–4 reps in reserve every set. No heavy squats/deadlifts.
plan.enterExercisesTrainerGave: Enter the exercises your trainer gave you. A week without a written plan repeats the previous week's workout. Weights are entered during the workout.
plan.leaveMealFieldEmpty: Leave a meal field empty to drop that meal from the plan. Meals whose text you did not change keep their calories and protein; newly written meals count as 0 kcal.
plan.previousWeeksPlanIn: The previous week's plan is in use
plan.revertToPreviousWeeks: Revert to the previous week's workout
plan.revertToPreviousWeeksPlan: Revert to the previous week's plan
plan.workoutModeCurrentlyBuilt: The workout mode is currently "Built-in program". Select "Trainer workout" in Settings for this plan to take effect.
safety.agreeWithDoctor: Agree with your doctor before moving to heavy loading. This program is not medical advice.
safety.doNotHold: Do not hold your breath on heavy sets (Valsalva) — breathe out as you lift.
safety.ifYouFeel: If you feel pain, swelling or heaviness in the groin/testicular area, stop the workout and see a urologist.
safety.inFirstWeeks: In the first weeks avoid maximal weights and heavy squats and deadlifts; prefer Leg Press and machines.
safety.supportiveCompressionAthletic: Supportive (compression) athletic underwear can add comfort.
settings.addWheyToMenu: Add whey to the menu if protein falls short
settings.allDataStoredOnly: All data is stored only in this browser's LocalStorage. Make a backup before clearing the browser.
settings.deleteAllDataThis: Delete all data? This cannot be undone.
settings.fileCouldNotRead: File could not be read — choose a valid FitFlow backup file
settings.newTargetsApplyTo: New targets apply to newly created menus.
settings.perBCycleAnd: The A/B cycle and phases are counted from this date
settings.regenerateSelectedDaysMenu: Regenerate the selected day's menu with the new settings?
settings.thisAppProvidesGeneral: This app provides general information and does not replace medical advice. Consult a urologist before moving to heavy loading after varicocele surgery.
supp.addWheyWhenCreating: Add whey when creating a menu if protein falls short
supp.creatineHoldsWaterIn: Creatine holds water in muscle, so the scale may show +0.5–1.5 kg in the first weeks — this is not fat.
supp.everyDayTrainingAnd: Every day — training and rest days
supp.iDrank1Scoop: I drank 1 scoop of whey (add to the daily total)
supp.steroidsTestosteroneSarmsProhormone: steroids, testosterone, SARMs, prohormones and other anabolic drugs. The goal is a natural result — protecting hormonal balance matters especially after varicocele surgery. Consult a doctor before taking any additional drug.
supp.wheyNotMainFood: Whey is not a main food — it is only for covering a shortfall when the protein target is not met with meals.
supp.withWaterOrFood: With water or food; no "loading" needed
tip.1015Minute: A 10–15 minute walk after a meal helps digestion and reduces bloating.
tip.cutBackOn: Cut back on fizzy drinks, chewing gum and drinking lots of water during meals.
tip.doCardioAt: Do cardio at a pace where you can talk (Zone 2, ~110–135 beats/min). The goal is heart health, not burning muscle.
tip.doNotEat: Do not eat a heavy meal 2–3 hours before bed; light protein (cottage cheese/yogurt) is fine.
tip.easyWalk6: An easy walk (6–8 thousand steps) and 10 minutes of stretching speed up recovery.
tip.eatLowFat: Eat a low-fat, low-fiber meal 60–90 minutes before training — it gives energy and reduces bloating.
tip.eatSlowlyAnd: Eat slowly and chew well — the simplest way to reduce bloating.
tip.hitProteinTarget: Hit your protein target today too — muscle recovery continues.
tip.inPostWorkout: In your post-workout meal get 40–50 g of protein and good carbs (rice/potato).
tip.keep13: Keep 1–3 reps in reserve on every exercise. For natural muscle growth there is no need to train to failure.
tip.keepCardioUnder: Keep cardio under 30 minutes — the main goal is building muscle.
tip.muscleGrowsPrecisely: Muscle grows precisely on recovery days. Pay special attention to sleep today: 7–9 hours.
tip.proteinTargetSame: The protein target is the same on rest days — 170–190 g.
tip.rest90150: Rest 90–150 seconds between sets; 2–3 minutes on heavy lifts.
tip.spreadWaterThrough: Spread your water through the day — do not drink a lot at once.
tip.todayProgressiveOverload: Today is a progressive overload day: beat last time’s numbers by at least 1 rep or a small weight increase.
tip.wrapUpWeek: Wrap up the week: average weight, waist, workout numbers — the trend matters, not a single day’s number.

workoutSvc.firstTimeStartWith: First time: start with the weight your trainer told you.
